title: Use a single fixed user-defined time zone for daily quote rotation (persisted)

requirements.text: Add backend support for a per-user fixed time zone setting that is stored persistently in the canister state (survives canister upgrades/redeploys). The time zone must be representable without relying on server-side IANA/DST rules (e.g., store a fixed UTC offset in minutes or a fixed "UTC±HH:MM" value) and must be retrievable and updatable by the logged-in user.
acceptanceCriteria: A logged-in user can set their fixed time zone value via a dedicated backend method.
A logged-in user can fetch their currently saved fixed time zone value via a dedicated backend query method.
The value is stored per Principal and remains intact after an upgrade/redeploy.
Unauthorized callers cannot set or read another user’s time zone setting.

requirements.text: Implement deterministic quote-of-the-day selection based on the provided static list of 50 quotes, rotating in order (1→50 then loop) and switching at midnight of the user’s saved fixed time zone. The computed daily quote must be stable for the entire day for that user, and must not depend on an external quotes API.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the same user time zone setting and the same day (as determined by that time zone), the backend returns the same quote consistently.
At the first moment after local midnight in the user’s saved fixed time zone, the returned quote advances by exactly one position in the list (looping after quote 50 to quote 1).
The quote rotation order is deterministic and does not reset when the canister is redeployed/upgraded.
The backend exposes a single method to fetch the user’s current daily quote (text + author + optional index/date metadata).

requirements.text: Update the frontend daily quote feature to use the backend as the quote source and to respect the backend’s fixed-time-zone daily rotation. If the user has not configured a fixed time zone yet, show an inline prompt in the quote area to set it (English text), and do not show “Quote unavailable” due to missing configuration.
acceptanceCriteria: The daily quote component renders a quote returned from the backend (not from https://api.quotable.io/random).
If no fixed time zone is configured for the current user, the quote area displays a clear call-to-action to set a time zone (in English) instead of showing an error state.
After the user sets a fixed time zone, the daily quote loads successfully without requiring a full page reload.
User-facing text introduced for this feature is in English.

requirements.text: Add an upgrade-safe state migration (only if required by existing deployed state) so that introducing persisted quote/time-zone state does not break existing stored data (e.g., habit tracking state) on upgrade.
acceptanceCriteria: Upgrading the canister preserves existing user habit/profile data.
New persisted structures for time zone and daily quote rotation are initialized safely for existing users (e.g., absent until set).
No runtime traps occur on first call paths after upgrade due to missing/old state.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo.
Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui or other frontend immutablePaths (compose existing UI components instead).
Use English for any new user-facing text.
nonGoals: Supporting automatic timezone detection from the browser.
Supporting IANA timezone names with DST-aware transitions.
Real-time quote updates/push notifications at midnight.
